name: strategy-terminal
description: Write trading strategies, run backtests and books, and read market data in the Strategy Terminal.

interface.longDescription: Write and revise trading strategies, run backtests, setups and books, compare runs and read market data in your Strategy Terminal. Connecting opens the terminal in your browser to sign in; the app then acts as you, with the access you allow.
defaultPrompt: List my strategies and their latest backtest results
Backtest my EMA cross strategy on XAUUSD for the last three months
Compare my two most recent runs and explain the difference
